source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original async send migration returns before prepareSendMsg when sendAutocryptHeaders is false. Later review explicitly identifies that skipped preparation as the source of an S/MIME-object error and records a partial backout. Fixed code awaits preparation independently, then handles the optional Autocrypt header separately. The retained compose-send-message event still has a cloudfile consumer. Tests were reported to miss the failing configuration; no send or crypto test ran.
title: OpenPGP preparation must not be gated by the optional Autocrypt header
